data.title: Nirmala Sandhu gave Lulu and Georgia 1 star. Check out the full review...
data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

May 26, 2023

## [no number for customer service](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6470fa2a706f837cb1f27256)
no number for customer service. email only and they take several days to reply. i did not receive my package and can not contact anyone directly.

May 26, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 27, 2023

Hello Nirmala, Thank you for reaching out, we’re so sorry to hear about these shipping errors and apologies for the inconvenience that this has caused. We can see you’ve been corresponding with our Customer Experience team today. They are looking into a lost package claim with FedEx and they will be following up with you shortly for a resolution.
